Introduction

Aseul, formerly known as Yukari, is a South Korean singer and musician under Astro Kidz. She officially made her debut on December 20, 2012 with the digital EP "Echo" under the name Yukari. She was part of the female duo YukariXSam. However, they only produced a few songs.
